data.body: CHECKPOINT: Implementation complete. Added compute_aggregate() returning {per_site, aggregate_reduction_pct, pre_head_sha, post_head_sha, tokenizer_name, status} with thresholds pass>=70%, partial>=50%, fail<50%. Added --report flag to CLI: runs capture → aggregate → writes JSON to output_path. Exits 0 on pass/partial, non-zero on fail. Added 6 new test functions (tests 11-16) covering all three threshold bands, required JSON fields, and write_report path. All 41 tests GREEN. ruff check passes.
